stats[0].detail: Hours an average company spent complying with tax obligations in Brazil — the outright world record in the last measurement of the series (global average: ~234h). The ranking was discontinued in 2021; no country came close.
stats[1].detail: The 'Custo Brasil': how much more it costs to produce here than in an average OECD country — around 19.5% of GDP, every year.
stats[2].detail: The backlog of fights between taxpayers and the tax authorities: R$ 5.69 trillion in administrative and court disputes — more than twice what all levels of government collect in a year.
stats[3].detail: Estimated standard rate of the new VAT created by the tax reform (CBS+IBS): the highest in the world, ahead of Hungary (27%). The law pegs the reference at 26.5%, but official estimates already run above it.
stats[4].detail: Tax rules issued since the 1988 Constitution — about 40 per working day. Simply keeping up with the changes costs companies ~R$ 279 billion a year.
